functions.purpose: Builds the AS3 UI VO array 'chapterArr' of mh.view.GuideBook.ChapterItemVo for the GuideBook (progression/tutorial reward book). Iterates chapter records at (guideMgr+0x2b28) and emits per-chapter {chapterID, chapterName, isOpen, isNew, isCanGetReward}.
formulas: Guide manager reached via DAT_1202e818->[0xd0]->[0x90]->vfunc[0xb4]() then +0x2b28 = chapter container.
Chapter array walk: base=*(cont+0x10), end=*(cont+0x14), stride = 0xf ints (0x3c bytes).
chapterID = *puVar5 (record[0]); isOpen = *(record+0xd) (byte); isNew = (*(record+0xf) == 0) (byte, inverted); isCanGetReward = FUN_1153a0a0() (per-record can-claim check).
chapterName resolved via FUN_100e5aa0 (localized string lookup).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (renders server-provided guidebook state; no mutation or cost validation here)
functions.notes: isCanGetReward is computed client-side for display; the server must still authorize the actual chapter-reward claim.

functions.purpose: Builds GuideBook chapter-detail UI VOs (case type==2): introductionArr (TextDescriptionVo), taskArr (TaskItemVo), rewardArr (RewardItemVo). Shows chapter progress, tasks, and claimable rewards.
formulas: curProgress compared as (iStack_c0 == *(FUN_1170a680()+0x3c)).
isWeaponChapter and isHasChooseWeapon (local_a0[2]!=0) emitted as bools.
finishActionCount = ppppppiVar7[1]; actionCount = (ppppppiVar7[7]-ppppppiVar7[6])>>2 (element count of an int vector).
TaskItemVo: detailDes (string), curCompleteNum = (*taskRec)[8], needCompleteNum = (*taskRec)[6][10].

RewardItemVo per index i in [0, rewardCount): getCondition = (float)FUN_11539f30(i+1); rewardID = *(FUN_1180a860()+4); rewardCount = 1 (hardcoded); isHasGetReward = FUN_11539960(i); finishCount = *FUN_1180a860().
reward loop count = (*(rewardMgr+0x20) - *(rewardMgr+0x1c)) >> 3.
costs: rewardCount is always displayed as 1 per reward entry (single-item rewards).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (display of server-authoritative task progress and reward-claim state)
functions.notes: Decompiler heavily mangled the frame (nested pointer types); offsets for TaskItemVo fields verified from string ordering only.

functions.purpose: Builds the equipment enhance/upgrade (enforce) UI data block (param_5==3): source-item stats plus a 'destEquipArray' of candidate upgrade targets, each with full cost/requirement fields. This is the client mirror of the server's upgrade cost table.
formulas: Top-level fields: roleLevel = CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount(); roleHunterStarLv = playerObj->vfunc[0x18]() + (FUN_1025b060()+FUN_1025b060()); sourceRare = item->vfunc[0x2c](); itemLevel = item->vfunc[0x18](); ItemRank = FUN_11669840(); bPointType = 1.
Per destEquip record walked at (iStack_20c+0x1c)..(+0x20), stride 0xb0 bytes.
Result array entries laid out at cursor iVar4 (base+0x5c), advancing +0x88 per entry then +0x2c inner. Field offsets relative to iVar4 (the +0x5c anchor of each entry):

equipID = *(e-0x50); enforceRequirement = *(e-0x58); hunterstarRequirement = *(e-0x54); equipRare = *(e-0x38); itemLevel = *(e-0x34); equipCounts = *(e-0x30); upgradeMoney = *(e-0x2c); currentMoney = *(e-0x28); rankDownLevel = *(e-0x24); enforceDownLevel = *(e-0x20); newRankLevel = *(e-0x1c); bBindState = *(e-0x10) (byte); enforceLevel = *(e-0x44); breakLevel = *(e-0x40); canBreak = *(e-0x3c) (byte); enforceRuleID = *(e-0xc).
&DAT_11dbb0b4 field (index) = *(e-0x4c).
Craft-credit cost fields: nCraftCreditID = *(e+4); nOwnCraftCredit = FUN_113fa380(*(e+4)) [owned amount of that craft-credit currency]; nCraftCreditMax = *(e+8); nCraftMoney = *(e+0xc).
equipHasEnoughMaterial hardcoded to 0 here (material sufficiency computed elsewhere).
costs: upgradeMoney (e-0x2c) = gold cost to upgrade; currentMoney (e-0x28) = money threshold/current.
nCraftMoney (e+0xc) craft-credit cost; nCraftCreditMax (e+8) cap; nOwnCraftCredit = FUN_113fa380(creditID) currently-owned.
functions.serverRelevance: validation/display (client shows server-provided upgrade costs & requirements; server must recompute and enforce upgradeMoney/craft cost & requirement gates on the actual upgrade action)
functions.notes: FUN_113fa380(id) is the recurring 'get owned count of currency/material id' accessor used throughout this chunk. The negative-offset cursor layout means each candidate-target record is ~0x88-0xb4 bytes.

functions.purpose: Builds UI VO for a guild-airship / occupied-level entry (param_5==3): guild vs captain comparison, ship status, occupancy players, and the level's reward payload (normal + delicate rewards, material drops).
formulas: isSameGuild = (strcmp(playerGuildName, ship+0x20) != 0) ? ... emitted as 1 when strings differ (uVar8!=0 branch sets 1).
isAttack = (strcmp(playerGuildName, ship+0x64) != 0).
shipStatus = ((uVar9 << 0x1d) >> 0x1d) = sign-extended low 3 bits of *(ship+0x60).
textFinishTimes = (uVar9 >> 3) & 0x1fff (bits 3..15 of *(ship+0x60)).
textTimeReamain = (*(ship+0xc) - iStack_88) + 0x4b0  [remaining time; +1200 constant offset].
levelID = *(ship+0x10); occupyTime = *(ship+0x14).
guildName=ship+0x40-region string; captainName=ship+0x40; captainGuild=ship+0x20; occupyHunterText=ship+0x64; occupyPlayer1..4 = ship+0x84/0xa4/0xc4/0xe4.

Reward block from ship-config (iStack_c4): shipId=*(cfg+0x10); delicateRewardId=*(cfg+0x78); delicateRewardNum=*(cfg+0x7c); normalRewardID=*(cfg+0x70); normalRewardNum=*(cfg+0x74); materialNum=*(cfg+0x64); materialTagType=*(cfg+0x60).
costs: normalRewardID/normalRewardNum and delicateRewardId/delicateRewardNum define the occupy reward items and counts; materialNum/materialTagType define material payout.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (display of server-owned occupy state and reward definitions)
functions.notes: 0x4b0 = 1200 (seconds) added to displayed remaining time. Reward numbers are read from static level/ship config, not computed.

functions.purpose: Registers AS3<->C++ message handlers for the MonsterCard research/lottery tab view: requests ReqCurTabData/ReqResearch/ReqRefresh and responses AS2C_GetCurTabData/AS2C_GetResearchData/AS2C_GetLotteryItemListByMonsterType, binding handlers FUN_109fbf30, FUN_109fc040, LAB_109fc550, FUN_109fc6a0, FUN_109fc7b0, FUN_109fc880.

functions.notes: Stock UI-framework registration pattern (FUN_100b62c0 create-name, FUN_109fd5c0 bind, FUN_10c3d5d0 free-temp-string).

functions.purpose: Registers message handlers for the MonsterCard exchange view: ReqCurTabData/ReqReward/ReqExchangePhyCard/ReqExchangeData -> FUN_109fdfe0, FUN_109fec60, FUN_109feb30, FUN_109fe5d0.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (UI message-routing table registration)

functions.purpose: Builds the current MonsterCard tab data VO (type==1): curSeriesNum, curCardType, cardGroupImageUrl, arrSeries, arrCardEntry (MonsterCardEntryVo per monster), and arrRewards (BaseItemVo list). Uses CIllustrateBookInfo::CollectByCategory to gather cards.
formulas: Card book manager at (uiMgr+0x2b1c). Series count = FUN_109d4570(); per-series record = FUN_109fdd40(i), included only if *(rec+0x44)!=0.
MonsterCardEntryVo: imageUrl = entry+0x18; monsterId = entry[4]; monsterName = entry+5; (&DAT_11dbdc0c field) = FUN_11537410(entry[4]) [collected/owned flag].
arrRewards BaseItemVo: itemID = rewardVec[5][i*2]; count = rewardVec[5][i*2+1]; name via FUN_10540d00(itemID)->+0x14. Count of rewards = ((rewardVec[6]-rewardVec[5])>>3).

functions.notes: FUN_10540d00(itemID) = item-base-info lookup by id; used repeatedly for item names.

functions.purpose: Builds the MonsterCard exchange-preview VO (type==1): cost items, owned counts, gain items, owned credit, and cost amount for the selected series/card-type exchange.
formulas: arrExchangeCostItem: BaseItemVo list from costCfg (iVar5) at *(cfg+0x14)..*(cfg+0x18), stride 8: itemID=*(base+i*8), count=*(base+i*8+1). Owned count per cost item = FUN_113fa380(itemID) -> emitted into arrExchangeCostItemOwnNum.
arrExchangeGainItem: BaseItemVo list from gainCfg (FUN_11809ca0-derived) same 8-byte stride layout.
ownCreditNum = player->vfunc[0x244]() (current owned exchange credit).
costNum = *(seriesCfg+0x48) (credit cost of the exchange).
seriesName = seriesCfg+0x18; cardTypeName = player+5; imageUrl = seriesCfg+0x1c.
costs: costNum = *(seriesCfg+0x48) exchange credit price; arrExchangeCostItem lists required item ids+counts; ownCreditNum is player's current credit balance (for affordability display).
functions.serverRelevance: validation/display (client previews the exchange cost; server must verify credit/items and perform the exchange authoritatively)
functions.notes: vfunc[0x244] on the player object is the exchange-credit balance getter for this feature.

functions.purpose: 2D config-table lookup into CPlayerVIPLevelUpInfo (VIP level-up thresholds). Returns the config value for a given level index, or 0 if out of range.
formulas: mgr obtained via CPlayerVIPLevelUpInfo::GetManager()/CInfoManager::FindByName.
Guard: level!=-1 && (level!=0 || mgr[0xc]==0) && mgr[10]!=0; then idx = level - mgr[0xc]; require 0<=idx<mgr[9].
row = *(mgr[8] + (idx / mgr[10]) * 4); if row!=0 return *(row + (idx % mgr[10]) * 4).
mgr[0xc]=base level offset, mgr[9]=total count, mgr[10]=columns-per-row (chunked 2D table).
functions.serverRelevance: config-lookup (shared VIP level-up threshold table; both client and server read the same config to gate VIP levels)
functions.notes: Standard MHO chunked-2D config accessor pattern (row stride mgr[10], base offset mgr[0xc]); reused verbatim by FUN_10b629d0, FUN_111ff230, etc.

functions.purpose: Constructor for the Forge (crafting) UI controller; registers model-string callbacks: RequireCraftMaterialId, EquipTypeSelcted, EquipSubTypeSelcted, ForgePagePre, ForgePageNext, OnStartForge, OnForgeClose, ForgeChk, RefreshForgeView.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (UI controller construction & callback registration)
functions.notes: Sets vtable PTR_FUN_11cc7b84; binds each named model field to a handler via CInfoRecord::GetModelString + vfunc[0xf0].

functions.purpose: Forge handler that, given a selected craftID, looks up CCraftInfo, checks whether the player owns enough of the required craft materials, and pushes the result (event 0x3d) to the UI.
formulas: craftID = *(param_2+8); early-out if <1.
CCraftInfo entry via chunked-2D lookup (mgr+0x20 base, +0x24 count, +0x28 cols, +0x30 base-offset), same pattern as FUN_10a03930.
Requirement check uses FUN_1025b060() hunter/stat counts vs *(craft+0x80) (required material threshold): compares single count and sum of two counts against *(craft+0x80).

local_10 (owned-material total) = FUN_113f9300(3,matListId,0) + FUN_113f9300(0,...) + FUN_113f9300(2,...) + FUN_113f9300(10,...), where matListId = *(craft+0x5c). Sums owned materials across bag categories {3,0,2,10}.
Emits struct {local_14=canFlag, local_10=ownedTotal, ...} via UI event 0x3d.
costs: *(craft+0x80) = required material count for the craft; *(craft+0x5c) = material-list/group id.
functions.serverRelevance: validation/display (client-side affordability preview; server is authoritative on actual craft material consumption)
functions.notes: FUN_113f9300(category, listId, 0) counts owned items of a bag category matching a material list; categories 0/2/3/10 appear to be bag partitions.

functions.purpose: Builds player level-up UI data (two blocks, UI events 0x87 and 0x252) from CPlayerLevelUpInfo (level/EXP curve) and CExplimitInfo (EXP cap). Shows current level, EXP, star level, and reward preview for current and next level.
formulas: current level = CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount(); level-up config row via CPlayerLevelUpInfo chunked-2D lookup (mgr+0x20/0x24/0x28/0x30).
*(levelRec+0x14) used as an EXP/threshold field emitted into local_40[0].
CExplimitInfo lookup (FUN_108dea50) by hunt rank -> emits *(rec+0x1c) and *(rec+0x18) as exp-limit fields (local_2c/local_28, local_64/local_60).
Several stat getters FUN_1025b060() populate current/next-level stat comparison; FUN_113974a0 returns paired values; FUN_116bd200()+0x30 supplies another field.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (display of level/EXP curve; server owns actual EXP & level)
functions.notes: FUN_1139a7e0/FUN_1139a680 are max-level/boundary predicates; FUN_11399090 fetches next-level exp pair when not at cap.

functions.purpose: Variant of the level-up UI data builder (UI events 0x87 and 0x252) using CPlayerLevelUpInfo, with a constant 1000 denominator field; shows current/next level EXP and reward preview.
formulas: local_3c = 1000 and local_74 = 1000 (fixed constant, likely EXP-percentage denominator / display scale).
current level = CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount(); CPlayerLevelUpInfo chunked-2D lookup; *(levelRec+0x14) emitted.
Reward preview via FUN_108d1810(level) -> *(rec+0x18)/*(rec+0x1c) when *(rec+0x14)!=0.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (level/EXP display)
functions.notes: Near-duplicate of FUN_10b611b0 but uses FUN_108d1810 (level-reward lookup) instead of CExplimitInfo; constant 1000 differs.

functions.purpose: Chunked-2D config lookup into CPlayerLevelUpInfo returning the level-curve entry (EXP threshold / reward record) for a given level, or 0 if out of range.
formulas: mgr = CPlayerLevelUpInfo::GetInfoManager(0,"CPlayerLevelUpInfo",0).
Guard: level!=-1 && (level!=0 || mgr[0x30]==0) && mgr[0x28]!=0; idx = level - mgr[0x30]; require 0<=idx<mgr[0x24].
row = *(mgr[0x20] + (idx / mgr[0x28]) * 4); return *(row + (idx % mgr[0x28]) * 4).
Field byte-offsets: base ptr @0x20, count @0x24, cols @0x28, base-level @0x30.
functions.serverRelevance: config-lookup (authoritative level/EXP curve table; server should use identical thresholds for level-up validation)
functions.notes: Same accessor shape as FUN_10a03930 but with byte offsets 0x20/0x24/0x28/0x30 instead of word indices 8/9/10/0xc.

functions.purpose: Formats a Tencent 'tgbang' analytics/beacon URL query string reporting role level (and qt=levelUp when flagged) and dispatches it via FUN_10b73f00.

Buffer size 0x823 bytes; snprintf-style via FUN_100ec3b0.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (external analytics beacon; not gameplay-authoritative)
functions.notes: Not economy logic; included because it fires on level-up. daid=45, jobid=1 are constants.

functions.purpose: Registers script/flowgraph enum constants into a script table: resource-quality, gather loot types (Mine/Herb/Insect/Fish/Mushroom/Honey/Stone/Body/Bone/Egg...), interest-point types, and the eMHGameEventID_* client event enumeration (~0x08..0x85).
formulas: eLootType_ order: Mine=1,Herb=2,Insect=3,Fish=4,Mushroom=5,Honey=6,Stone=7,Shit=8,Remain=9,Body=10,BrokenPart=11,Bone=12,Egg=16,Web=17,Other=18 (values as floats).
eMHGameEventID_* integer enum registered via FUN_10d1cc20(name,id) from 8..0x85; notable: AddCraft=9, BeginCraft=10, BeginLoot=0xb, VipLevelNotify=0x76, LevelUnlockNotify=0x6d.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (script/flowgraph constant registration; loot-type taxonomy is shared vocabulary)

functions.purpose: Serializes a {CraftID} request and sends it to the server as message id 9 (matches eMHGameEventID_AddCraft/BeginCraft family). Client->server craft request.

Dispatched via FUN_10d1d220(model+0x58, 9, ...). Guarded by empty-queue check on model+0xac lists at +0x100/+0x108.
functions.serverRelevance: client request (server authoritative: must validate craft cost/materials before crafting)
functions.notes: Message id 9. CraftID is the only payload; all cost enforcement is server-side.

functions.purpose: Serializes {CraftID, Discount} and sends it to the server as message id 10 (0xa). Client->server craft request carrying a discount value.
formulas: CraftID = (float)*param_2; Discount = (float)param_2[1]; both AS number values (tag 4).
Dispatched via FUN_10d1d220(model+0x58, 10, ...). Queue guard on model+0xac at +0x11c/+0x124.
costs: Discount field is client-supplied; server MUST NOT trust it — recompute discounted price authoritatively.
functions.serverRelevance: client request (SECURITY: discount is client-provided; server must validate/derive it, never accept the client value as the price)
functions.notes: Message id 0xa.

functions.purpose: Serializes an equipment-enforce/enchant request {m_nItemID, m_nItemColumn, m_nItemGrid, m_nEnforceRule, m_nEnforceLevel, m_nBufferID} and sends it to the server as message id 0x52. Client->server upgrade request.
formulas: Payload fields (all AS number tag 4): m_nItemID=(float)param_2[0], m_nItemColumn=param_2[1], m_nItemGrid=param_2[2], m_nEnforceRule=param_2[3], m_nEnforceLevel=param_2[4], m_nBufferID=param_2[5].
Dispatched via FUN_10d1d220(model+0x58, 0x52, ...). Queue guard on model+0xac at +0x8fc/+0x904.
functions.serverRelevance: client request (server authoritative on enforce success/cost; must validate item ownership at column/grid, rule, and consume the money/material/craft-credit costs from FUN_109f3df0's table)
functions.notes: Message id 0x52. Pairs with the enforce-cost view builder FUN_109f3df0.

functions.purpose: Lazily initializes the reflection/TDR field schema for an 'ordinary drop reward' network message: enable, playerNetId, addExp, addBindGold, addUnBindGold, OrdinaryDropItem, OrdinaryDropItemCount, plus a Result sub-struct.

Field descriptors built at globals DAT_120340e8.. via PTR_FUN_11df7674/11df7734 constructors; param_1 populated with {&fields, &Result, &empty, flags|0x10}.
costs: Message conveys server-computed reward amounts: addExp, addBindGold, addUnBindGold, OrdinaryDropItem(+Count).
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (this is the wire schema for a reward the SERVER computes and pushes: EXP + bound/unbound gold + drop item/count). Bind vs unbind gold distinction is significant.
functions.notes: 'addBindGold' = bound (non-tradeable) currency; 'addUnBindGold' = unbound (tradeable) currency. Schema only; the actual grant is server-side.

functions.purpose: Lazily initializes the reflection field schema for a reward-state network message: enable, rewardSstate (sic), plus a Result sub-struct.
formulas: Init guarded by DAT_120340c0 bits 1/2; descriptors at DAT_12034078..
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server-pushed reward-claim state message schema)
functions.notes: 'rewardSstate' is the shipped (typo) field name — preserve exact spelling on the wire.

functions.purpose: Lazily initializes the reflection field schema for a wave/layer reward-config message: layer, modelGroupID, delayStartTime, rewardTime, rewardExp, rewardBindGold, rewardUnbindGold, rewardItemGroupID, addPlayerBuffID, addBossBuffID, isHaveReward, resouceID, monsterID, monsterNum.

costs: Per-wave reward payload: rewardExp, rewardBindGold, rewardUnbindGold, rewardItemGroupID (item-group id for loot table).

functions.notes: Looks like a tower-defense / monster-wave (modelGroupID, monsterID, monsterNum, boss buff) reward definition. resouceID spelled as shipped.

functions.purpose: Lazily initializes the reflection field schema for a reward message carrying: enable, playerNetId, addExp, addBindGold, addUnBindGold, OrdinaryItemGroupID, plus Result.

costs: Server-computed grant: addExp, addBindGold, addUnBindGold, and OrdinaryItemGroupID (item-group id resolved to concrete drops server-side).
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (sibling of FUN_10e357c0 but references an item GROUP id rather than a single item; server rolls the group into concrete items)
functions.notes: Distinguishes bound vs unbound gold like the other reward messages.

functions.purpose: Locates the 'aircraft' sub-entity/proxy on an entity, invokes an attach vfunc, then releases a ref-counted temp (decrementing DAT_123be268 allocator counter).

functions.serverRelevance: client-only (entity/vehicle plumbing; not economy)
functions.notes: Included for completeness; unrelated to progression/economy.

functions.serverRelevance: client-only (entity component init; not economy)
functions.notes: Stock CryEngine entity-XML parsing.

functions.purpose: Level-up reaction: plays the 'Energy_Ability_PC.BUF.LevelUp' particle effect, runs level-up logic (FUN_1139ab90), and if a predicate holds fires client event 0x4ce with the player's hunt rank.

Event 0x4ce dispatched with FUN_1024e8a0(CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount(2)).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (level-up presentation; server owns the level change that triggers it)
functions.notes: 90.0f likely an effect duration/height; 0.5f an offset.

functions.purpose: Chunked-2D config lookup into CActivityLotteryInfo (lottery/gacha activity table); returns the entry for a given index or 0.
formulas: mgr = CActivityLotteryInfo::GetInfoManager(0,"CActivityLotteryInfo",0).
Guard: idx!=-1 && (idx!=0 || mgr[0x30]==0) && mgr[0x28]!=0; k = idx - mgr[0x30]; require 0<=k<mgr[0x24].
row = *(mgr[0x20] + (k / mgr[0x28]) * 4); return *(row + (k % mgr[0x28]) * 4).
functions.serverRelevance: config-lookup (lottery activity table; server must own draw odds/rewards, client uses same table for display)
functions.notes: Same chunked-2D accessor pattern as FUN_10b629d0.

functions.purpose: For a lottery activity entry (looked up in CActivityLotteryInfo), joins a client-provided list of fixed-width (0x20) strings and fires the entry's UI/flow event (*(entry+0x1c)) with the concatenated argument.
formulas: Activity index = *param_1; string count = (byte)param_1[1]; strings start at (param_1+5), each 0x20 bytes.
Join with separator (&DAT_11d9dc4c/11d9dc4d) between entries; event id = *(entry+0x1c); dispatch via FUN_1112f070(eventId, joinedStr) with mode 0x2a.
Only runs if *(entry+0x1c) > 0.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (UI/flow trigger; the lottery draw itself is a separate server-authoritative action)
functions.notes: FUN_1112f070 is the generic UI-event/flash dispatch used across this chunk.

functions.purpose: Handles the server craft-result: processes the result (FUN_1124f8f0); on success (param_1[1]==0) reads owned craft-credit and pushes event 0x60, advances the 'Smith_crafting' tutorial step at guide id 0x75a2, and fires UI event 0x11a with code 0x3d; on failure fires 0x11a with code 0x56.
formulas: Success gate: param_1[1] == 0.
On success owned craft-credit = FUN_113fa380(*(item+0x84)) where item = FUN_107ec240(*param_1); pushed via message id 0x60.
Tutorial: if current guide == 0x75a2 advance 'Smith_crafting' step.
UI event 0x11a payload = 0x3d (success) or 0x56 (failure).
functions.serverRelevance: client reaction (server already decided craft success/cost; this only updates local UI + owned-credit display)
functions.notes: 0x75a2 = a specific guide/step id; 0x3d and 0x56 are UI sub-codes.

functions.purpose: For a given craftID, looks up CCraftInfo, iterates its required-material list and, per material, resolves name/icon from CItemBaseInfo (fallback 'test item'/'2.png'), reads owned count, and pushes each entry to the UI via message id 0x3c.
formulas: CCraftInfo entry via chunked-2D lookup (mgr+0x20/0x24/0x28/0x30).
Material list walked at *(craft+0x120)..*(craft+0x124), stride 8 bytes (int pairs): materialItemID=*piVar8, requiredCount=piVar8[1].
Owned count = FUN_113fa380(materialItemID). Item name via CItemBaseInfo chunked-2D lookup -> local_5c; icon = *(itemInfo+0xb4).
Per-material struct {name[0x20], icon[0x20], requiredCount=local_18, ownedCount=uStack_14, itemID=iStack_10, index=iStack_c} pushed via message id 0x3c.
costs: requiredCount (piVar8[1]) = quantity of each material the craft consumes; *(craft+0x120) is the material-list head.
functions.serverRelevance: validation/display (client renders craft material requirements + owned counts; server enforces consumption)

functions.purpose: Player persistent-attribute deserializer: given a DB/config field name, a value, and the character struct base, matches the name and writes the value to the correct struct offset. This is effectively the full authoritative player-attribute schema (currency, EXP, level, VIP, clan, weapon proficiency, farm, PVP, face customization).
formulas: Dispatch: for each name, iVar1=FUN_100ec310(name,"<Field>"); if match, *(base+OFFSET)=value; return 1. (int32 unless noted undefined2=int16.)

costs: Defines the exact persistent fields the server owns and must be authoritative over: CharMoney/CharBoundMoney (gold, unbound/bound), CharCredit/CharBoundCredit (credits), CharCatCredit, CharReviveCredit, PVPMoney, CharCatMoney(+week/weekMax cap), HuntSoul, ClanMoney/ClanMoneyPVP, TotalCredit(float), WeekMoneyGain, plus all *Exp fields.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (schema map): although this function is client-side deserialization of server-sent character data, every offset here is a server-owned persistent field. Currency mutations (CharMoney/BoundMoney/Credit/etc.) and all EXP/level fields MUST be computed and validated server-side. CharCatMoneyWeek + CharCatMoneyWeekMax indicate a weekly earn cap the server must enforce.
functions.notes: ~5.9KB linear name->offset dispatch (FUN_100ec310 = string compare). Cross-ref TLV CharacterAttributes.md uses a base 0x14 higher (CharLevel@0x1c vs @0x8 here) — this is a distinct client mirror struct, but field identities match. Bound vs unbound money is a core distinction: BoundMoney/BoundCredit are non-tradeable. TotalCredit is unusually stored as a float.
